mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% over two consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when this trigger is met.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) of more than 2% coincident with a housing starts (HOUST) drop of more than 10% in the prior quarter signals weakening aggregate demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY change < -2% AND HOUST QoQ change < -10%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly different from zero in triggered periods (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 1% for four consecutive months indicates contraction in manufacturing output, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO monthly change < -1% for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in at least 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both the unemployment rate and a fall in payroll employment (PAYEMS) of more than 100,000 in a month signals a significant labor market deterioration, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases AND PAYEMS decreases by >100,000 in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not negative in at least 70% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate held steady at or below 1% for six consecutive months during a period of low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2% YoY) signals accommodative monetary policy, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS <= 1% for six consecutive months AND CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly above zero in at least 60% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase of more than 2% in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals robust consumer demand, which typically boosts corporate earnings and supports higher equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive in at least 60% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly decline of more than 1% in both industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based contraction in economic activity, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO monthly change < -1% AND HOUST monthly change < -1%
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered months.
